title: Paneer Butter Masala

items: 1 cup onions, cubed (use white not red)
600 grams paneer, cubed (soaked in hot water for 20 minutes)
1 Tbsp fresh kasuri methi (fenugreek) or (1 tsp dry)

steps: Using medium-saute mode: dry roast the bay leaves, kashmiri chili, cinnamon, cardamom, star anise, and coriander until fragrant; about 30-60 seconds.
Add tomatoes, onions, ginger, garlic, and cashews and pressure cook for 15 minutes.
Quick release the pressure and remove the pot to let it cool for 5-10 minutes.
After the mixture has cooled, transfer to a blender and puree until smooth.
Add 1 cup of water and puree again. (Blending a slightly thickened mixture first will help ensure a smooth paste.)
In a large pot (or instapot), heat the ghee until shimmering, then add kashmiri powder and garam masala, frying until fragrant.
Add the puree, salt, sugar, paneer, and kasuri methi, and cook for an additional 10 minutes.
Right before serving, stir in the cream and garnish with cilantro.
